description: A strip marker does not remove the left-to-right mark U+200E
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The left-to-right mark U+200E is in Pattern_White_Space, the set Unicode recommends for syntax (UAX #31), but it has no White_Space property and is not a space separator (Zs). hashicorp/hcl keeps it: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
